g.text: Linearized batch plots distinguish zero-, first-, and second-order kinetics
Three separate hypothetical irreversible, isothermal, constant-volume batch experiments, all starting at C_A0=2 mol/L. Zero-order plot ends before reactant
exhaustion. Linear fit quality and residuals, measurement errors and mechanism must be assessed; transformations can change error structure.
